The '''magic rock''' was a stone that had been blessed by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] and given to [[Mace Towani]] to help him in his search for [[Towani family|his parents]], who had been kidnapped by [[Gorax/Legends|gorax]]. When the rock was broken open, an arrowhead was found inside that pointed towards the direction of the Gorax fortress.
